name: host-file
description: Converge a file on the host running apply — inline content or a SOPS secret value, mode enforced, `changed` output for sequencing restarts
instructions: Host-converging module: apply writes the file on the machine running apply. Exactly one of `content` (inline) or `secretKey` (a key in environments/<env>/secrets.yaml) supplies the bytes; only rewrites on difference, so downstream instances can key restarts off outputs.changed.
